myQuotas.title: My quotas
myQuotas.description: These are your effective resource limits, site-wide shared pools, and user or role mail quotas.
myQuotas.loadFailed: Failed to load your quotas. Please try again later.

activeMailboxes.label: Active mailboxes
activeMailboxes.help: Only unexpired mailboxes count. A zero limit means unlimited.

mailboxLifetime.label: Maximum new-mailbox lifetime
mailboxLifetime.help: Measured in days. Unlimited permits permanent mailboxes.

messageBytes.label: Inbound message size
messageBytes.help: Counts raw bytes including headers, body and encoded attachments.

activeApiKeys.label: Usable API keys
activeApiKeys.help: Keys that are enabled and unexpired; shown for reference.

myQuotas.precedenceHelp: The site-wide total is always checked, plus one user or role rule. Other users may consume a displayed shared balance.
myQuotas.noRules: No matching quota rules. This direction is unlimited unless another permission or resource limit denies it.
myQuotas.roleSharedHelp: All members of your role consume the same total and domain counters, so this is not a personal balance. Per-mailbox limits remain isolated by user and full address.
myQuotas.userScopedHelp: Total and domain counters include only this account. Per-mailbox quotas are tracked separately for every full address.
myQuotas.totalRule: All domains: up to {limit} messages every {value} {unit}.
myQuotas.mailboxRule: Each mailbox: up to {limit} every {value} {unit}; lifetime maximum {lifetime}.
myQuotas.noOverrides: No additional domain or exact-mailbox overrides.
myQuotas.mailboxUsageHint: A mailbox's rolling usage and lifetime balance appear above its message list. Administrators can inspect and reset detailed counters under Access & quotas.

apiKey.title: API Key Management
apiKey.description: Create and manage API keys for accessing OpenAPI
apiKey.name: Key Name
apiKey.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete API key {name}? This action cannot be undone.

docs.note1: Replace YOUR_API_KEY with your actual API Key
docs.note2: /api/config endpoint provides system configuration including available email domains
docs.note3: emailId is the unique identifier for an email
docs.note4: messageId is the unique identifier for a message
docs.note5: expiryTime is the validity period in milliseconds: 3600000 (1 hour), 86400000 (1 day), 604800000 (7 days), 0 (permanent)
docs.note6: domain is the email domain, get available domains from /api/config endpoint
docs.note7: cursor is for pagination, get nextCursor from previous response
docs.note9: expiresIn is the share link validity period in milliseconds, 0 means permanent
docs.note10: shareId is the unique identifier for a share record
